data.long_meaning: Sadaqatun is an Arabic name for girls which means 'righteous deeds, charity, giving, alms'. It is derived from the word 'sadaqah', meaning charity, generosity, or righteous deeds. The name reflects the virtues of kindness, generosity, and charitable giving, which are highly valued in Islam. The name Sadaqatun carries the meaning “Alms, Charity, Giving” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Sadaqatun usually hope their child will grow to embody alms, charity, giving and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sadaqatun is a name that evokes a sense of spiritual generosity and giving. It encourages the bearer to be kind and charitable, not only to those around her, but also to herself. By embodying the spirit of giving and generosity, she will be a source of inspiration and positivity for those around her.
data.etymology: Sadaqatun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Alms, Charity, Giving.”
